name: com.github.doqltl179.mu3library.base
description: A modular architecture framework for Unity featuring custom DI (Dependency Injection), MVP UI pattern, Audio/Scene management, WebRequest, Observable pattern, and more. Supports optional packages like UniTask, Addressables, and Localization.

samples.description: Comprehensive samples showcasing Core system, MVP pattern, Audio, WebRequest, Addressables, and Localization. Needs the Input System package with Active Input Handling set to "Input System Package (New)" or "Both": its scenes' EventSystem uses InputSystemUIInputModule. Addressables, Localization, and UniTask are optional.

ConditionalHide and ButtonInvoke attribute usage examples for Inspector customization. Needs the Input System package with Active Input Handling set to "Input System Package (New)" or "Both": its scene's EventSystem uses InputSystemUIInputModule.
